No clinical diagnosis, validated P identity, or numeric PR/QRS/QT measurement is supplied.
Manual visual selection of candidate windows is necessary. Automatic pixels alone do not establish a ventricular event or physiologic apex identity.
Only the visible selected-apex window is summarized. No unseen edge event, missing beat, or whole-strip duration is inferred.
Approximately one-pixel fiducial uncertainty and resampling are possible. Unverified strip speed is a separate systematic limitation.
This work does not publish, modify runtime content, or alter original images.
Each band is recomputed separately for every original page, even where printed grid pixels are identical. No line count or pitch is inherited from another page.
Actual observed local gaps are 4-6 pixels. No inferred/interpolated grid lines were inserted; no nominal whole-strip duration was assumed.
The minor-division interpretation follows the visible nested grid and course context. Raster pitch is measured; time calibration remains assumed.
The edge apex at about x 94 is visible despite its truncated onset. Interval arithmetic uses apices only and does not require an onset estimate.
The first spike's rising onset is clipped by the left strip edge, but its apex and following descent are visible. Its visible apex is retained; no earlier event is invented.
No visible interior dominant spike is omitted. Smaller intervening baseline deflections are not counted as ventricular fiducials.
No additional dominant spike is visible after the last selected spike before the right edge. The trailing baseline is not used to infer an interval.

Conditional selected-apex-window mean only, assuming 25 mm/s and each visible minor division representing 1 mm, as supplied by course context on pages 228/230; neither is independently labeled/verified on this strip.
Unlabeled top marks are not calibration evidence. No six-second or whole-strip counting method is used.
No individual-interval rates are projected. Varying baseline and morphology, raster resolution, and unverified per-strip speed limit precision.
Calibration uses directly observed segment coordinates, not an inherited total or inferred whole-strip duration. Unlabeled marks do not verify timing.
Pixel and grid sensitivity allowances are illustrative, not confidence intervals. They do not bound unknown speed, missed events, waveform identity or phase-comparability errors.
